### Figure 1

```{r map}
library(rworldxtra)
library(rworldmap)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

world <- getMap(resolution = "high")
world_sf <- st_as_sf(world)

bal_countries <- c("Sweden")

world_bal <- world_sf[
  world_sf$ADMIN %in% bal_countries,
]

Coord <- data.frame(
  latitude = 60.3945,
  longitude = 18.1824,
  names = "Forsmark"
)

```


```{r map plot }
baltic <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = world_bal,
    fill = NA,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = Coord,
    aes(
      x = longitude,
      y = latitude
    ),
    size = 6,
    colour = "firebrick"
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(10, 28),
    ylim = c(55, 70),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Longitude") +
  ylab("Latitude") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "black"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )
```

# Geochemical data

```{r gas data}
Gasdata_KFM <- read_excel("data/Gasdata_all.xlsx", 
                               sheet = "Rtable", col_types = c("text", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "text", "date", "numeric", "numeric", 
                                                                         "numeric", "numeric", "text", "text", 
                                                                         "text", "numeric","numeric"))

Gasdata_KFM$H2[Gasdata_KFM$H2 == 0] <- 1e-3  

Gasdata_KFM$Source <- as.factor(Gasdata_KFM$Source)

Gasdata_KFM <- Gasdata_KFM %>%
  mutate(Name = paste(Borehole, Section, sep = ":"))

Gasdata_KFM2 <- read_excel("Gasdata_KFM2.xlsx") 

```

### Figure 3
```{r Figure 3}
cols.gas <- c( "HE"= '#56B4E9',"CO2" ="#009E73", "N2"= "#0072B2", "H2"= "#D55E00", "CH4"=  "#CC79A7", "C2H6"= "#F0E442", "C3H8"="#E69F00" , "O₂+Ar"="purple")

gasdata <- melt(Gasdata_KFM, id.vars =c("Borehole", "Section", "WaterType", "Comments on Values", "Source", "Sample_date", "Elevation", "NORTHING_WC_SECMID", "EASTING_WC_SECMID",'Name'))

filtered_data <- gasdata %>%
  filter((variable %in% c("HE","CO2", "N2", "H2", "CH4", "C2H6", "C3H8","O₂+Ar")))

filtered_data_sum <- filtered_data %>%
  group_by(Name, variable) %>%
  summarise(value = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# Normalise to proportions
filtered_data_norm <- filtered_data_sum %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(value),
         proportion = value / total * 100) %>%
  ungroup()

filtered_data_norm$variable <- factor(
  filtered_data_norm$variable,
  levels = names(cols.gas)
)

filtered_data_norm <- filtered_data_norm %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  mutate(total_prop = sum(proportion)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(variable = factor(variable, levels = unique(variable[order(total_prop)])))

ggplot(filtered_data_norm, aes(x = Name, y = proportion, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols.gas) +
  labs(y = "Gas Proportion (%)", x = "Borehole", fill = "Gas") +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "", base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))  +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title=element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x=element_text(size=14,, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y=element_text(size=14,, color = "black"),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),       
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15), 
        legend.direction = "vertical"        
  )

extremes <- Gasdata_KFM2 %>%
```

```{r prepare files}

clean_taxonomy <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(species = gsub("[a-z]__", "", species)) %>%
    separate(
      species,
      into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species"),
      sep = ";",
      fill = "right",
      remove = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(across(
      c(domain, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species),
      ~ ifelse(.x %in% c("unclassified", "Unclassified", "", NA),
               "Unclassified", as.character(.x))
    )) %>%
    filter(domain != "unmapped") %>%
    mutate(taxon = coalesce(species, genus, family, order, class, phylum))
}

DNA <- read.csv("data/DNA_relative_abundance_by_species.csv")

rename_map <- c(
  "KFM02a.2" = "KFM02A_2",
  "KFM02a.3" = "KFM02A_3",
  "KFM02a.5"   = "KFM02A_5",   
  "KFM24.1"    = "KFM24_1",  
  "KFM24.2"    = "KFM24_2",  
  "KFM24.3" = "KFM24_3",
  "KFM04.A.DNA1" = "KFM04A_1",
  "KFM04.A.DNA2" = "KFM04A_2",
  "KFM04.A.DNA3" = "KFM04A_3",
```

```{r top taxa selection}
get_dominant_family <- function(long_df, min_abund = 0.01, min_samples = 2) {
  long_df %>%
    group_by(family, sample) %>%
    summarise(rel_abund = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(flag = rel_abund >= min_abund) %>%
    group_by(family) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = sum(flag), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(n_samples >= min_samples) %>%
    pull(family)
}

dominant_family_DNA <- get_dominant_family(bintax_long_DNA)
dominant_family_RNA <- get_dominant_family(bintax_long_RNA)


forced_family <- c(
  "Methanobacteriaceae",
  "Methanomethylophilaceae",
  "Methanospirillaceae"
)

family_to_show <- unique(c(
  dominant_family_DNA,
  dominant_family_RNA,
  forced_family
))

make_plot_df <- function(long_df, family_to_show) {
  long_df %>%
    mutate(
      family_plot = case_when(
        family %in% family_to_show ~ family,
        family == "Unclassified" ~ "Unclassified",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(sample, family_plot) %>%
    summarise(abundance = sum(abundance), .groups = "drop")
}

DNA_plot_df <- make_plot_df(bintax_long_DNA, family_to_show)
RNA_plot_df <- make_plot_df(bintax_long_RNA, family_to_show)

family_order <- function(plot_df) {
  plot_df %>%
    group_by(family_plot) %>%
    mutate(total_abundance = sum(abundance)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      family_plot = fct_reorder(family_plot, total_abundance, .desc = TRUE),
      family_plot = fct_relevel(family_plot, "Other", "Unclassified", after = Inf)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-total_abundance)
}

DNA_plot_df <- family_order(DNA_plot_df)
RNA_plot_df <- family_order(RNA_plot_df)

DNA_plot_familyified <- DNA_plot_df %>% filter(family_plot != "Unclassified")
RNA_plot_familyified <- RNA_plot_df %>% filter(family_plot != "Unclassified")
```

```{r create methanogen/acetogen data set}
parse_tax <- function(df, col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(tax = gsub("[a-z]__", "", .data[[col]])) %>%
    separate(
      tax,
      into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species_rank"),
      sep = ";",
      fill = "right",
      remove = FALSE
    )
}

DNA_tax <- parse_tax(DNA_relative_abundance_by_species, "species")
RNA_tax <- parse_tax(RNA_relative_abundance_by_species, "species")

definitions <- tibble(
  tax = c(
    # methanogens
    key_genes_methanogenesis_acetoclastic$taxonomy,
    "d__Archaea;p__Methanobacteriota;c__Methanobacteria;o__Methanobacteriales;f__Methanobacteriaceae;g__UBA349;s__UBA349 sp023249725",
    "d__Archaea;p__Thermoplasmatota;c__Thermoplasmata;o__Methanomassiliicoccales;f__Methanomethylophilaceae;g__JAQUUA01;s__",
    # acetogens
    acetogens$tax
  )
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tax)) %>%
  mutate(tax = gsub("[a-z]__", "", tax)) %>%
  separate(
    tax,
    into = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species_rank"),
    sep = ";",
    fill = "right"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(family),
    trimws(family) != "") %>%
  distinct(domain, phylum, class, order, family)

acet_meth_DNA <- DNA_tax %>%
  semi_join(
    definitions,
    by = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family")
  )

acet_meth_RNA <- RNA_tax %>%
  semi_join(
    definitions,
    by = c("domain","phylum","class","order","family")
  )

acet_meth_merged <- acet_meth_DNA %>%
  left_join(
    acet_meth_RNA,
    by = "species",
    suffix = c("_DNA", "_RNA")
  )
```

```{r define the paired DNA and RNA samples}
library(purrr)
eps <- 1e-6

paired_samples <- tibble(
  site = c(
    "KFM04A",
    "KFM04A",
    "KFM04A",
    "KFM04A",
    "KFM10A",
    "KFM10A"
  ),
  
  sample = c(
    "KFM04A-FH1-20231019-1",
    "KFM04A-FH2-20231019-2",
    "KFM04A-FH1-20231020-1",
    "KFM04A-FH2-20231020-2",
    "KFM10A-FH3-20231020-1",
    "KFM10A-FH4-20231020-2"
  ),
  
  DNA = c(
    "KFM04.A.DNA1",
    "KFM04.A.DNA2",
    "KFM04.A.DNA3",
    "KFM04.A.DNA4",
    "KFM10.A.DNA1",
    "KFM10.A.DNA2"
  ),
  
  RNA = c(
    "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH1.20231019.1",
    "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH2.20231019.2",
    "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH1.20231020.1",
    "Forsmark.KFM04A.FH2.20231020.2",
    "Forsmark.KFM10A.FH3.20231020.1",
    "Forsmark.KFM10A.FH4.20231020.2"
  )
)

#build dataset
activity_long <- map2_dfr(
  paired_samples$DNA,
  paired_samples$RNA,
  
  function(dna_col, rna_col) {
    
    tibble(
      species = acet_meth_merged$species,
      
      family = acet_meth_merged$family_DNA,
      order = acet_meth_merged$order_DNA,
      phylum = acet_meth_merged$phylum_DNA,
      domain = acet_meth_merged$domain_DNA,
      
      DNA = as.numeric(acet_meth_merged[[dna_col]]),
      RNA = as.numeric(acet_meth_merged[[rna_col]])
    )
  },
  
  .id = "pair"
) %>%
  
  left_join(
    paired_samples %>%
      mutate(pair = as.character(row_number())),
    
    by = "pair"
  )
```

```{r aggregate to family level}

activity_family <- activity_long %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(family),
    family != ""
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    site,
    sample,
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    DNA = sum(DNA.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    RNA = sum(RNA.x, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  
  mutate(
    log2ratio = log2(
      (RNA + eps) /
        (DNA + eps)
    )
  )

activity_family %>%
  count(site, sample)

nrow(activity_family)

activity_family %>%
  dplyr::select(site, sample, domain, phylum, order, family, DNA, RNA, log2ratio)

family_abundance <- activity_family %>%
  group_by(
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_DNA = mean(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_DNA = max(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

abundance_threshold <- 0.0000001
families_to_keep <- family_abundance %>%
  filter(
    max_DNA >= abundance_threshold
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  )

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family %>%
  semi_join(
    families_to_keep,
    by = c(
      "domain",
      "phylum",
      "order",
      "family"
    )
  )

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    domain = if_else(
      is.na(domain) | domain == "",
      "Unclassified",
      domain
    ),
    phylum = if_else(
      is.na(phylum) | phylum == "",
      "Unclassified",
      phylum
    ),
    order = if_else(
      is.na(order) | order == "",
      "Unclassified",
      order
    )
  )

# calculate DNA abundance per phylum
phylum_abundance <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  group_by(
    domain,
    phylum
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_DNA = mean(DNA, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    domain_order = case_when(
      domain == "Archaea" ~ 1,
      domain == "Bacteria" ~ 2,
      TRUE ~ 3
    )
  )

# order phyla
phylum_order_table <- phylum_abundance %>%
  filter(domain != "Archaea") %>%
  arrange(mean_DNA)

archaea_phyla <- phylum_abundance %>%
  filter(domain == "Archaea") %>%
  arrange(mean_DNA)

phylum_order_table <- bind_rows(
  archaea_phyla,
  phylum_order_table
)

phylum_levels <- phylum_order_table$phylum

# order families according to their phylum
# within each phylum, keep families together
family_order_table <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  distinct(
    domain,
    phylum,
    order,
    family
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_levels
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    phylum,
    family
  )

family_levels <- family_order_table$family

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    phylum = factor(
      phylum,
      levels = phylum_levels
    ),
    family = factor(
      family,
      levels = family_levels
    )
  )

activity_family_filtered <- activity_family_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    domain = factor(
      domain,
      levels = c(
        "Bacteria",
        "Archaea",
        "Unclassified"
      )
    )
  )
```

```{r dotplot}
  labs(x = "Pathway", y = "Sample")
```

## Supplemental Figures
### Supplemental Figure 1
```{r alpha diversity}
library(vegan)

comm <- as.data.frame(t(DNA))

richness <- specnumber(comm)

shannon <- diversity(comm, index = "shannon")

evenness <- shannon / log(richness)

alpha_div <- data.frame(
  sample = rownames(comm),
  richness = richness,
  shannon = shannon,

  evenness = evenness
)

alpha_div

alpha_div <- alpha_div %>%
  mutate(borehole = sub("_.*", "", sample))  # extract borehole from sample name

shapiro.test(alpha_div$shannon)

kruskal.test(shannon ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(richness ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(evenness ~ borehole, data = alpha_div)

pairwise.wilcox.test(alpha_div$shannon,
                     alpha_div$borehole,
                     p.adjust.method = "BH")
```

### Figure 5
```{r RDA}
samples <- rownames(comm)
borehole <- sub("_.*", "", samples)
env <- read_excel("data/environmental.xlsx")
env <- env[match(borehole, env$Borehole), ]
rownames(env) <- samples

comm_hel <- decostand(comm, method = "hellinger")

env_clean <- env[, colSums(is.na(env)) == 0]

env_clean <- env_clean %>% dplyr::select(-C2H6, -C3H8)

env_num <- env_clean[, sapply(env_clean, is.numeric)]
cor(env_num, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

rda_full <- rda(comm_hel ~ ., data = env_num)

vif.cca(rda_full)

RsquareAdj(rda_full)

env_reduced <- env_num[, c("pH")]

rda_model <- rda(comm_hel ~ pH, data = env_reduced)
summary(rda_model)
vif.cca(rda_model)

anova(rda_model, permutations = 999)

anova(rda_model, by = "term")
anova(rda_model, by = "axis")
envfit(rda_model, env_clean)

borehole <- factor(sub("_.*", "", rownames(comm_hel)))

# Fit envfit
ef <- envfit(rda_model, env_num, permutations = 999)

# site scores for plotting
site_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(rda_model, display = "sites", scaling = 2))
site_scores$sample <- rownames(site_scores)
site_scores$borehole <- borehole

# Extract only significant vectors for plotting 
env_vectors <- as.data.frame(scores(ef, display = "vectors", scaling = 2))
env_vectors$variable <- rownames(env_vectors)
env_vectors <- env_vectors[ef$vectors$pvals <= 0.05, ]  # only significant

var_explained <- summary(rda_model)$cont$importance[2, 1:2] * 100

hulls <- site_scores %>%
  group_by(borehole) %>%
  slice(chull(RDA1, PC1))

# Range of site scores 
max_range <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$PC1)))

# Autoscale environmental arrows to 60% of plot range
env_vectors$RDA1 <- env_vectors$RDA1 / max(abs(env_vectors$RDA1)) * max_range 
env_vectors$PC1  <- env_vectors$PC1  / max(abs(env_vectors$PC1))  * max_range 

env_vectors$lab_x <- env_vectors$RDA1 * 1.05
env_vectors$lab_y <- env_vectors$PC1  * 1.0

```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls,
               aes(RDA1, PC1, fill = borehole),
               alpha = 0.2,
               color = NA) +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(RDA1, PC1, color = borehole),
             size = 4) +
  geom_segment(data = env_vectors,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = PC1),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.35, "cm")),
               color = "black",
               linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_text(data = env_vectors,
            aes(RDA1, PC1, label = variable),
            size = 4.5,
            color = "black",
            vjust = -1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.20))  +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  labs(
    title = "Redundancy Analysis (RDA) of Microbial Communities",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", round(var_explained[1], 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_explained[2], 1), "%)"),
    color = "Borehole",
    fill = "Borehole"
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
  )

```

### supplementary Figure 2
```{r beta diversity}
dist <- vegdist(comm, method = "bray")

pcoa <- cmdscale(dist, eig = TRUE, k = 2)

scores <- as.data.frame(pcoa$points)
colnames(scores) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")

scores$sample <- rownames(scores)
scores$borehole <- borehole

var_exp <- round(pcoa$eig / sum(pcoa$eig) * 100, 1)

hulls <- scores %>%
  group_by(borehole) %>%
  slice(chull(PCoA1, PCoA2))

ggplot(scores, aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, color = borehole)) +
  geom_polygon(data = hulls,
               aes(fill = borehole),
               alpha = 0.2,
               color = NA) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PCoA of Microbial Communities (Bray–Curtis)",
    x = paste0("PCoA1 (", var_exp[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PCoA2 (", var_exp[2], "%)"),
    color = "Borehole",
    fill = "Borehole"
  )

```

```{r count of proteins}
metaproteomeDB_proteins <- read_excel("data/longradient_metaproteomeDB_proteins.xlsx",

proteins <- metaproteomeDB_proteins %>%

proteins_forsmark <- proteins %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -all_of(c("Found in Sample: F11: Sample, 06" ,"Found in Sample: F10: Sample, 05",
                     "Found in Sample: F9: Sample, 04", "Abundances Count: F11: Sample, 06",
                     "Abundances Count: F10: Sample, 05", "Abundances Count: F9: Sample, 04",
              "Abundance: F11: Sample, 06","Abundance: F10: Sample, 05","Abundance: F9: Sample, 04")))

Acetyl <- proteins_forsmark %>%
  filter(Description %in% c("Acetyl-coenzyme A synthetase", 
                            "Acetate kinase", 
                            "Phosphate acetyltransferase", 
                            "Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase",	
                            "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit beta",

  dplyr::select(

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%

  )

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -KFM04A_count1,
    -KFM04A_count2,
    -KFM04A_abundance1,
    -KFM04A_abundance2

Acetyl <- Acetyl %>%
  mutate(
    Description = recode(

      "Carbon monoxide dehydrogenase/acetyl-CoA synthase subunit alpha" = "Acetyl-coenzyme A synthase subunit alpha"
    )

Acetyl_counts <- Acetyl %>%

Acetyl_abund <- Acetyl %>%

abund_long <- Acetyl_abund %>%

)
```

```{r peptide analysis}

peptides <- read.csv("data/peptides.csv")
deepbio_GCs_basic <- read.csv("data/deepbio_GCs_basic.csv") 
names(deepbio_GCs_basic)[1] <- "gene_cluster"

library(tidyverse)

peptides_tax <- peptides %>%
  left_join(
    deepbio_GCs_basic %>%
      select(gene_cluster, lca_tax, KO_name, KO),
    by = "gene_cluster"
  )

peptides_tax %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    no_gene_cluster = sum(is.na(gene_cluster)),
    no_lca = sum(is.na(lca_tax)),
    has_lca = sum(!is.na(lca_tax))
  )

peptide_detections <- peptides_tax %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("FoundIn."),
    names_to = "sample",
    values_to = "detection"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    borehole = case_when(
      str_detect(sample, "KFM04") ~ "KFM04",
      str_detect(sample, "KFM010") ~ "KFM10",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(detection))

peptide_borehole <- peptide_detections %>%
  group_by(
    `Annotated.Sequence`,
    short,
    gene_cluster,
    lca_tax,
    KO_name,
    KO,
    borehole
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    n_samples_detected = n(),
    detections = paste(unique(detection), collapse = "; "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

peptide_borehole %>%
  summarise(
    total_peptides = n_distinct(short),
    tax_assigned = n_distinct(short[!is.na(lca_tax)]),
    ko_assigned = n_distinct(short[!is.na(KO)]),
    both_assigned = n_distinct(short[!is.na(lca_tax) & !is.na(KO)])
  )
```
